about: Ultimate Mode safe zone characters. Every safe zone background (evt_amb_ name) has exactly one character; each character has its own Kokoro voice. accent gb means the line phonemes are in Misaki British notation (Kokoro lang code b); us means American (lang code a).

groups.name: Cold and storms, machines and space

characters.name: Mother Hazel
characters.personality: A kindly, mischievous old witch who speaks in riddles, brews the potions and changes her mind about everything.

characters.name: Mortimer
characters.personality: A gentle, patient gravekeeper who rakes leaves, talks to headstones and thinks the world is a garden.

characters.name: Pell
characters.personality: A cheerful little ghost girl who claims she remembers every world and is looking for her own front door.

characters.name: Jangles
characters.personality: A joking skeleton fiddler who is sure the world is a song that keeps going back to the top.

characters.name: Marigold
characters.personality: A chatty village market trader who sells apples, candles and, above all, rumours.

characters.name: Tobias
characters.personality: A steady old night watchman who keeps the lamps lit, pours cocoa and writes everything odd in his logbook.

characters.name: Mister Pendle
characters.personality: A fussy, precise clockmaker and station master who times every rebuild and hates surprises.

characters.name: Chef Rosalind
characters.personality: A warm, bossy chef who thinks the world is a recipe somebody keeps tasting and starting again.

characters.name: Juniper
characters.personality: A bubbly young counter worker who collects her regulars' theories on napkins.

characters.name: Grandpa Hollis
characters.personality: A jolly old storyteller by the fire whose every legend has several versions.

characters.name: Cinder
characters.personality: A gruff, loud fireworks maker who takes his fire from the lava and believes the world is forged.

characters.name: Ambrose
characters.personality: A calm, gentle organist who hears the world as unfinished music.

characters.name: Prudence Quill
characters.personality: A prim, quiet librarian and keeper of records who thinks the world is a book being read again.

characters.name: Captain Brine
characters.personality: A deep voiced old sea captain full of sea stories, sure something under the sea keeps count.

characters.name: Willa
characters.personality: A friendly river ferry keeper who collects things that float down from old worlds.

characters.name: Fennick
characters.personality: An eager young marsh warden who loves rain and frogs, especially a frog called Admiral.

characters.name: Petra
characters.personality: A careful, quiet cave explorer who counts drips and believes the world is built from the bottom up.

characters.name: Rowan
characters.personality: A calm forest ranger who reads the trees and the crickets.

characters.name: Ivy
characters.personality: An excitable jungle explorer who has searched a hundred worlds for the edge of the map.

characters.name: Wren
characters.personality: A bright young bird watcher who is sure the birds know the answer and sing it too fast.

characters.name: Clover
characters.personality: A sunny beekeeper who calls everyone sugar and trusts her bees to find their way home.

characters.name: Sol
characters.personality: A slow, thoughtful wanderer who has walked to the edge of the world and found more road.

characters.name: Lady Rime
characters.personality: A cool, elegant lady of the ice who keeps frozen pieces of old worlds.

characters.name: Corbin
characters.personality: A gruff, kind mountain shepherd who thinks the wind is the world breathing.

characters.name: Mister Sprocket
characters.personality: An enthusiastic inventor who collects lightning and is certain the world is a machine.

characters.name: Commander Vega
characters.personality: A cheerful space commander who watches the world from orbit and calls you cadet.
